key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Blades broadly ovate to nearly orbicular or 3–5-lobed, 50–120 mm long and wide, base cordate, surfaces hairy. Leaf shape is variable and should not be used alone.

key_traits.label: Sepals
key_traits.text: Five sepals, about 12–24 mm long; proximally broader/ovate, then abruptly narrowing into a long curved or spreading distal tip. At least the proximal portion is hirsute to hispid.

key_traits.label: Corolla
key_traits.text: Light blue, funnel-shaped, usually about 20–37 mm long (sometimes to ~45 mm), with a white to pale-yellow inner tube.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Capsule; seed characters may be useful in difficult identifications.

key_traits.label: Flowering
key_traits.text: May–November in Flora of North America treatment.
